focus: Explain the Adam update rule (Algorithm 1): exponential moving averages of the gradient and squared gradient, bias correction, and the resulting step. Let the learner change beta1, beta2 and the step size and step through iterations on a simple 1-D function. Show m_t, v_t, their bias-corrected versions and the step. Explore why bias correction matters in the first steps.
audience: Engineering undergraduate who knows gradient descent
